svg.title: Other heat loads reduce the line-count budget

cc:Work.dc:title: Other heat loads reduce the line-count budget
cc:Work.dc:description: All quantities refer to the same hypothetical temperature stage. The line-only bound is 500; a 4 μW fixed load reduces it to 300. This is accounting, not a refrigerator specification.
